content.content: This layer restores a whole deccy operation via op restore given the boundary's operation id. Only whole deccy operations — no partial, file-level, or snapshot restore exists at this boundary.
content.rationale: Undo and redo restore pre- and post-operation boundaries of deccy operations, not bare jj operations; fixing whole-deccy-operation restore as the single write half keeps every intermediate state a valid graph by construction. Exact restore argv stays with the contract level, where fake-binary tests prove it.
